Description: Entity Text Description: gives the Text Descriptors Object of a Text Object. The descriptors are the 28 scores of a GoEmotions classifier (RoBERTa-base, 28 emotion labels, each score the probability that the text expresses that label), 28 numbers in the order of the labels of GoEmotions; the Qualifier of the Object names the format (GoEmotions Scores (RoBERTa-base, 28-d)). PS-Text Interpretation turns them into the Text Personal Status.
